'''ER-1B''' was an [[ER-1 probe droid]] built by [[Graf Zapalo/Legends|Graf Zapalo]] and a team of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] engineers. ER-1B was put to work exploring the mysterious ocean tunnels of Naboo.
